title: keyboard
description: Keyboard layouts, the layout switch bind, extra XKB options and key repeat. Personal: presets never carry it.

layout.description: XKB layout code, e.g. us, ru, de.

variant.description: XKB variant, e.g. intl; empty for none.

switchBind.title: Switch bind
switchBind.description: Key combination that cycles the layouts.

options.title: Options
options.description: Extra XKB options (e.g. ctrl:nocaps), besides the switch bind.

repeatDelay.title: Repeat delay
repeatDelay.description: Delay before a held key repeats.

showIndicator.title: Show indicator
showIndicator.description: Show the active layout (EN, RU, ...) in the bar.
